scope: Independent read-only assessment of the finite-height hypothesis for the confirmed Q12 diagnostic clipping.

finding.assessment: The cold-mounted maximum-text flow captured the frame/line callbacks before its screenshot, so 219.9999pt versus 5×44pt is a plausible native final-line fit/height-rounding hypothesis. It remains unconfirmed: the line callback reports four lines and the screenshot shows right-edge truncation; no authored fixed-height cap exists in the component.

smallestUsefulExperiment.method: Compare the existing baseline against a temporary target-only minHeight: 221 on the message Text, with maximum supported text applied before opening the same completed review item. Pair target Text onLayout, onTextLayout, immediate ancestor frames, and screenshot for each pass.
preserve: existing item, selection, Details state, and completed session
no submission, reset, or session recreation
compare: reported line count and summed line heights against Text frame height
each line width against available Text width
whether the extra point permits the trailing phrase to wrap and render
smallestUsefulExperiment.purpose: Test whether a frame just below five 44pt line boxes is sensitive to one additional point, without presupposing a cause or turning the temporary diagnostic value into product styling.

limitations: No device, simulator, source, or session changes were made by this reviewer.
The five-line arithmetic does not establish an authored frame constraint; a target-only extra-height comparison has not yet been run.
No cause or repair is confirmed, and this is not a Q12 or full BIZQ-01 acceptance result.
